content: Bhela, mtumika wa kunani kumahundi jola akanangi nkoka wa machi gha womi, ukabhi ung'anya ngati chioo, ukabhi unyila kuhumi pa chiteu cha kikolongwa chaka Chapanga na chaka Mwanambelele.

Nkoka hoghu ukabhi upeta pachilanda ja indela ngolongwa ja muchi hoghu. Kila upambala wa nkoka hoghu kukabhi na nkongu wa womi ghoukabhi upambika mapambiku mala komi na ibheli kwa chaka, yani upambika mapambiku kila mwehi, na mahamba gha nkongu hoghu nde mitela ja kubhalamiha bhandu bha mataifa ghokapi.

Mkati ja muchi ghonihoghu ngakwikubhi na chindu chechibhi na masolu kabhete. Na chiteu cha kikolongwa chaka Chapanga na chaka Mwanambelele anachikubhaje mkati ja muchi hoghu, na bhatumika bhaki anabhuntumakyaje.
Anabhapabhona pamihu jake, na lihina laki analilembakikaje panani ja ibhongi ya pamihu jabho.
Ngakwikubhi kabhete na ikilu, wala ngabhipali unang'anu wa taa au wa lyobha, maghambu Bambo Chapanga anaabhapekya unang'anu waki, nabhombi anabhatawa mileli na mileli.
Kuhika kwaka Yesu

Bhela, mtumika wa kunani kumahundi jola akambwaghile, “Malobhi aghagha nde gha kuhobhaleka na gha chakaka. Bambo Chapanga ambaju abhapekeha bhalota Roho waki, akuntumiki mtumika waki wa kunani kumahunde abhalangiha bhatumika bhaki mambu ambaghu ghapalika ghapitalya manyata.”
Yesu apwagha, “Lingalyaje! Nhika manyata! Apengaliki mundu jola joakamula malobhi gha ulota wa chitabu chenu!”

Nepani Yohana, nde nenaghaweni na kughajowana mambu ghani ghokapi. Panajomwi kughajowana na kughabhona ghanihagha, nakachikimi pahi palongi ja magholu ghaka mtumika wa kunani kumahunde joakanangi mambu ghani ghokapi, na kupala kunjojabhela.
Nambu jombi akambwaghile, “Lingalyaje, ngawihenga bhenibhela! Nepani nde mtumika pela ngati wehapa na bhalongu bhaku bhalota na bhokapi bhabhaghakamu malobhi gha chitabu chenu. Unjojabya Chapanga!”
Kabhete akambwaghile, “Ngaughajeghela muhuli malobhi gha ulota ghaghabhi mu chitabu chenjenu, maghambu chikahi cha kupitalila mambu ghanihagha chiheghalile.

Mundu joahenga mahakau na ajendalyaje kuhenga mahakau, joahenga ghangakupalika na Chapanga na ajendalyaje kuhenga bhenibhela. Mundu joahenga ghambone na ajendalyaje kuhenga ghambone, na mhuhu na ajendalyaje kubha mhuhu.”
Yesu apwagha, “Lingalyaje! Nhika manyata! Na malepu ghangu ghabhi mumabhoku ghangu, kundepa kila mundu kulengana na lihengu laki leahengike.
Nepani nde Alufa na Omega, wa Kutumbula na wa Kujomukela, Utumbulilu na Ujomukelo.”
Bhapengaliki bhandu bhala bhabhachapa ingobhu yabho, nahuli bhapata kujetakalewa kuujendela nkongu hoghu wa womi, na kujingila mu muchi hoghu kupetela mu milyangu jake.
Nambu kunja ja muchi hoku kubhi na nakawa, bhahabhi, bhagone, bhabhakoma, bhabhajojabhe imong'umong'u, na kila mundu joapala kupwagha upuhe na kuutenda.
“Nepani Yesu, nuntumiki mtumika wangu wa kunani kumahunde kundandi mwehapa mambu ghanihagha mu makanisa. Nepani nde Mbelakeka mu lukolu lwaka Daude, ndondwa jela jejing'anya ja lukela.”
Roho waka Chapanga na mabhu ndowa bhapwaghaje, “Uhikaje!”

content.text: Na jokapi joabhi na inywita na ahikaje, na kila joapala na aghatola machi gha womi waka.

content: Ujomulelo

Nepani Yohana, nundakalila kila mundu joaghajowana malobhi gha ulota wa chitabu chenjenu: Mundu jokapi anaajonjukili chokapi mu mambu ghangani, Chapanga anaanjonjukya malapuliku ghaghalembakiki mu chitabu chenu.

Na ngati mundu jokapi anaapungwizi chokapi mu malobhi gha ulota ghaghabhi mu chitabu chenjenu, Chapanga anaanyaghulaje pandu paki mu nkongu ghola wa womi, na pandu paki mu Muchi Uhuhu, ambau malobhi ghaki ghalembakiki mu chitabu chenu.
Jombi joalandila mambu aghagha apwagha, “Chakaka! Nhika manyata!” Amina. Uhikaje, Bambo Yesu!
Chihomu chaka Bambo Yesu chikubhaje papamu na mwehapa mabhokapi. Amina.
